meta_description:
415K likes, 1,389 comments - farahdhukai on February 14, 2021: "How it started vs how it’s going

@lifeofsal 10 years ago today, you asked me to come hang out and I said no...cuz it was cold and I was too lazy to wash my hair.
.
Somehow you convinced me to come out and then when I got to you, you blindfolded me and told me we’re going for a drive and throughout that entire 45+ minute blindfolded drive, I was convinced that you were taking me somewhere to murder me, especially when you told me you were surprising me with a puppy, so I was thinking of a master escape plan because who blind folds someone for a long car ride and surprises them with a puppy...
.
little did I know, you were driving me to the exact spot we first met and were going to ask me to marry you😭😭😭now i understand why you sounded so nervous the whole car ride!! It wasn’t because you were going to lock me in an abandoned warehouse... you were gonna propose!
.
happy ten year proposal anniversary aka Valentine’s Day aka the day I thought you were going to kill me! Love you thanks for not murdering me also thanks for putting up with my wild imagination 😊❤️
.
#valentinesday #ineedtostopwatchingcrimedocumentaries #happyvalentinesday #farahdhukai".
